documents.title: VideoAR reference
documents.summary: VideoAR is an augmented driving guidance experience for next-generation in-vehicle displays.
facts: It helps drivers interpret maneuver and navigation context more intuitively.
The public overview states it is built with C++ and Android-Kotlin.
It is relevant across premium vehicle display concepts.
The linked SharePoint PDF is the internal reference for deeper project context.

documents.title: Shud onboarding
documents.summary: SHUD is a slope head-up display experience that combines driving guidance with navigation context.
facts: SHUD stands for Slope Head-Up Display.
Its focus is situational awareness and driver support in the driving context.
It follows modern display integration patterns for immersive HUD guidance.
The linked SharePoint PDF is the internal onboarding reference for the project.
